title: Background Remediation Coordination
objective: Coordinate implementation of approved snapshot remediation items in the background while foreground governance documentation and planning work continues.
foregroundConstraint: Do not block current governance documentation work unless an implementation item needs explicit operator approval, runtime mutation, destructive cleanup, external publication, or branch/commit action.
tasks: Create a background implementation queue from the approval packet.
Separate items into read-only preparation, repo documentation work, git checkpoint work, runtime/security work, network/filesystem work, and destructive cleanup.
Prepare implementation plans and diffs in the background where safe.
Do not execute gated mutations without explicit operator approval.
Return approval prompts only when an item is ready to cross a mutation boundary.

backgroundQueue.title: Staged worktree checkpoint by artifact class
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Plan checkpoint batches and identify exact file groups without staging, committing, resetting, or altering the index.

backgroundQueue.title: Redacted secret inventory report
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Prepare a redacted inventory plan listing secret names and locations only. Do not print or persist secret values.
approvalRequiredBefore: runtime secret read that may reveal values

backgroundQueue.title: Fresh clone comparison for nunncorp-global-mono
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Prepare comparison checklist and target directory plan. Do not clone or modify filesystem outside approved workspace without approval.

backgroundQueue.title: Generated runtime map as authoritative evidence
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Prepare runtime map template and required fields from existing Infrastructure Truth Report. Refresh live runtime only after approval if needed.

backgroundQueue.title: Deeper public label check and remediation diff
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Scan public labels and prepare proposed diffs for review. Do not publish externally.

backgroundQueue.title: Internal pilot onboarding kit draft
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Draft internal-only pilot onboarding kit using verified public-safe claims and no secret or repo-internal diagnostic details.

backgroundQueue.title: Architecture diagram inventory and index
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Inventory existing diagrams and prepare sanitized diagram index. Do not create new architecture claims.

backgroundQueue.title: Governance standards review checklist and invariant validation
backgroundQueue.backgroundAction: Create checklist for held governance standards and validate invariants across the drafted stack. Do not promote any standard.

rules: Do not normalize the Git index unless explicitly approved.
Do not commit, stage, unstage, branch, push, or reset without approval.
Do not rotate secrets or mutate runtime.
Do not promote held governance standards.
Background work may prepare docs, checklists, templates, and proposed diffs where safe.
Any mutation boundary must return an approval request before execution.
